title: get root info returns bsopt optimized api message
description: Verify that a GET request to the root endpoint '/' returns a 200 status code with the message 'BS-Opt Optimized API' indicating the API is running and responding correctly.

title: get health returns healthy status
description: Verify that a GET request to the '/health' endpoint returns a 200 status code with a JSON body containing {"status": "healthy"}, confirming the API health check is operational.

title: get metrics returns prometheus metrics text
description: Verify that a GET request to the '/metrics' endpoint returns a 200 status code with Prometheus metrics in text format, ensuring observability metrics are exposed correctly.

title: post auth register creates new user with jwt token
description: Verify that a POST request to '/api/v1/auth/register' with valid email, password, and full_name creates a new user and returns a 201 status code with a user object containing a JWT token.

title: post auth login returns access token for valid credentials
description: Verify that a POST request to '/api/v1/auth/login' with valid email and password returns a 200 status code with an access_token and token_type bearer, allowing authenticated access.

title: get auth me returns user profile with valid token
description: Verify that a GET request to '/api/v1/auth/me' with a valid Authorization bearer token returns a 200 status code with the authenticated user's profile information.

title: post pricing calculate returns option price and greeks
description: Verify that a POST request to '/api/v1/pricing/calculate' with valid pricing parameters and Authorization bearer token returns a 200 status code with the calculated option price and greeks.

title: get portfolio returns user portfolio
description: Verify that a GET request to '/api/v1/portfolio' with a valid Authorization bearer token returns a 200 status code with the user's portfolio data.

title: post portfolio positions adds new position
description: Verify that a POST request to '/api/v1/portfolio/positions' with valid position data and Authorization bearer token returns a 201 status code with the created position.

title: post graphql returns valid graphql response
description: Verify that a POST request to '/graphql' with a valid GraphQL query or introspection query returns a 200 status code with the expected GraphQL response data.
